#2.1.0 Update Details
 
Agents,
 
It is time to unveil the full contents of Marvel Future Fight 2.1.0.



▣ 3 New Tier-2 Characters
 
 Thanos, Supergiant, and Ebony Maw join Future Fight!
 

 * You will be able to obtain these characters in World Boss Mission only.
 * These characters will require other characters Biometrics to level up.
 
 New Team Bonuses and Achievements have been added for the new characters.
 
▣ New Tier-1 Character
 
 Crossbones joins Future Fight!
 

 * Crossbones is obtainable through the 1 Year Anniversary Token Box.

 
New Team Bonus and Achievements have been added for Crossbones.
 
▣ 4 New Uniforms
 
 New Uniforms released for Team Captain. Captain America, Hawkeye, Falcon, and Winter Soldier will all receive uniforms.
 

 * You can get new uniforms at a discounted price for a certain period.
* Team Iron-Man and the Ant-Man uniforms are coming soon
 
 
 
▣ New 6★ Skill
 
 New 6★ Skill has been added for Falcon!
 

 
  - Falcon(Include Uniforms): Air Superiority
 
▣ Character Advancement & New Passive Skills
 
 1. New Feature – Advancement (Tier-1>Tier-2)
The following characters can be upgraded from Tier-1 to Tier-2 assuming the conditions are met.
-Captain America, Iron man, Black Widow, Hawkeye, Falcon, Winter Soldier, and Ant-Man
 
  [Advancement?]
   A character which is Advanced from Tier-1 to Tier-2 will gain a stat increase, as well as a new passive skill.
 
  The following conditions need to be met in order to Advance.
 
  [Conditions]
   - Rank: Rank 6
   - Mastery: 6 Star Mastery
   - Level: Level 60
   - Gears: All gears at +20
 
 You can see the Advancement button if the selected character can be advanced to Tier-2.
 

 
If you satisfy all the conditions and you have enough gold and materials, you can proceed with advancing.  
Press [Advancement] Button to Advance!
 

You can see their stats without advancing in the Marvel Universe tab!
 

 
 New achievements have been added for advancing a character to Tier-2.
 
 2. New Tier-2 Passive Skills
   New Tier-2 Passive Skills have been added to Captain America, Iron Man, Black Widow, Hawkeye, Falcon, Winter Soldier, and Ant-Man!
 
  * New Passive Skills will be added after Tier-2 Advancement

 

 
 - Captain America(Include Uniforms): Hold The Line
 - Iron Man(Include Uniforms): Evasive Maneuvers
 - Black Widow(Include Uniforms): Tactical Advantage
 - Hawkeye(Include Uniforms): Refocus shot
 - Falcon(Include Uniforms): Defense Increase
 - Winter Soldier(Include Uniforms): All-out Assault
 - Ant-Man(Include Uniforms): Elusive Hero
 
▣ Faction Battle

 
 Faction Battle has been added as a limited time event!
 
 Your actions in the field will add collectively to the points of your faction, and will ultimately determine if your choice wins or loses the battle.
 Rewards will be sent based on ranking and participation in the event.
 
 First of all, you must choose a side. (If one side is considerably larger than the other, players will have to choose the less popular side.)
 
 

  * You cannot change sides after you have picked one.
 
 If you select the side, you will see the icon in the middle of the screen to check the current rating of the factions.
 If you choose not to pick a side, you may choose later by tapping the Faction Battle icon to bring up the “Choose a Side” menu.
 

 
The result of the Faction Battle depends on the side with the most power.
 
You must enter missions and battles to collect Faction Points to raise your faction’s share of points.
 

 
 
▣ Special Gear Improvement
 
 1. New Options Available in Special Gears
  New options have been added. These new options are available when you try to upgrade special gear. Here is the options you may possible to get
 
 
 2. New Rank for Special Gears and Decrease in Upgrade costs
   New ranks for Special Gear (+3 ~ +5) have been added
Costs of upgrading Special Gears has been decreased, see the table below for more information.
 
 
▣ Timeline Battle Improvement
 
 1. League system has been added in Timeline Battle
   To boost the competition between the users, Timeline battle has been divided in to 5 leagues. You will also be matched with other players in your league.
 
 Your league may change based on your results. It is possible to be promoted, relegated or even remain in the same league.
 


  * Screenshot taken from test server. Promotion/Relegation conditions may change
  * League reset will be every Friday 1:00 (UTC+0), Thursday 5:00 PM (PDT)
 
 Make sure that you must login Before the League reset (and after the update) to be placed into the right league!
 Check out the notice [Sneak Peak 4: League Distributions in 2.1.0]for more information.
 
 2. Honor Card Chest
You can use Honor Token to get comics cards by purchasing Honor Card Chest.
Thor’s Biometrics are removed from the Honor Token Shop.
 
 
▣ Comics Card Improvement
 
 You may use Comics Cards easier in this update.
 
 1. Ease of Use Improvement
  - You are now able to move around your cards with the arrow to check card information!
 
 
 - Auto Select feature has been added to select other card for upgrade.
  If you tap the button again, selected material will be unselected.

 
 2. Max HP Option Improvement
  The activation bonus “+Max HP” has been improved. It will now boost your remaining and total HP.
 
 3. Equipping Card Improvement
  If you are trying to equip the card in the same slot that is already taken by another card, you can compare the cards between current equipped card and your selected card.
 

 
 4. Mythical Card Combination
  If you have extra Mythical Cards, you may use it to combine and change the option of an existing card!
  It is also possible to receive a Quality 7 card through the mythical upgrade!
 
  1) Select the card you want to change quality, and tap Combine
 

 
2) Select another Mythical card you will going to combine and tap combine to proceed
 * Quality and Option may change after combination!

 
3) You can see the result screen after combination.

 
▣ World Boss Improvement
 
  For your ease of use, World Boss Mission window has been improved.
 
 1. Main window
  You can now see exactly when each world boss will be opened again.
 

 
 2. Continue
  If you fail to defeat the World Boss, you will be able to spend Crystals to continue fighting with the same team.

 
 * Continue is not available in Thanos(Infinity) Mission
 * You can continue up to 5 times
 * Continue count will reset after server reset.
 
 3. Striker Improvement
  More Strikers are on their way to help your battle against World Boss!
Maximum of 3 Strikers can appear at the same time during battle!
  * Due to the maximum number of strikers has been increased, striking rate has been reduced slightly.


 * New Striker feature is only available in World Boss Mission.
 
※Due to the schedule changes with World boss, some item's amount has been modified. This amount will still be comparable to the previous version 

▣ Alliance Battle Improvement
 
 1. Alliance Battle Entry Consuming
 
   Due to the unexpected crashes, Alliance Battle Entries consumption has changed.
 
  - Before: Consumes after enter
  - After: Consumes after you’ve got the Rewards
 
  * If you fail to get the reward, your entry will not consumed
 
 2. Point Requirement for the last reward has been decreased
 
  - Frost Beast Day : 280,000 → 265,000
  - Meteor Day: 168,800 → 160,000
 
  * If the Frost Beast kills other enemies, you may not able to get the last reward - Biometrics
 
 3. Biometrics Reward has been modified
   - Phase 9 Biometrics: 7
   - Phase 10 Biometrics: 10
 
▣ Character Skill Improvement
 
1. Following character’s skill activate condition has been changed from Attack to when the Attack hits.
 
   - Hulk (Secret Wars: Future Imperfect) : Uniform Skill
   - Blade : Daywalker
   - Thor : The Power of Asgard
   - Black Cat : Misfortune
   - Gamora (Including Uniforms) : Skilled Assassin
   - Malekith : Dark Aberration
   - Destroyer (Prometheus) : Uniform Skill
   - Drax (Including Uniforms) : Quick Reflexes
   - Mocking Bird (Include Uniforms) : Battle Expert
   - Bobby Morse (Agents of S.H.I.L.E.D.) : Uniform Skill
   - Falcon (All-New, Captain America) : Uniform Skill
   - Iron Fist (Including Uniforms) : Heart of Shou-Lao, Power of Shou-Lao
   - Black Panther : Predator Frenzy
   - Bullseye (Including Uniforms) : Attacking a Vital Point
   - Hulkbuster  (Iron Man Mark 43) : Uniform Skill
   - Nebula : Stunning Grace
   - Giant-man (Including Uniforms) : Increase
   - Wasp : Paralyzing Sting
   - Yellowjacket : Fear of Sting
   - Sister Grimm : Energy Drain
   - Daisy Johnson (Including Uniforms) : Tremors
   - Deathlok (Modern) : Uniform Skill
   - Lash (Modern) : Uniform Skill
   - Elsa Bloodstone (Secret Wars) : Uniform Skill
   - Proxima Midnight : Relentless Pursuit
   - Thor (Jane Foster) : Thunder Might
 
2. Black Widow (Including Uniforms)
- Fixed an issue with "Systema", "Coup de Grâce” skills not hitting correctly
- Fixed an issue with normal attack not hitting correctly
 
3. Ant-Man (Including Uniforms)
 - “Ant Endurance” activation chance has been improved from 25% to 30%
 
▣ Hero Ranking System
 
 In this menu, you will see which characters are used most in Story Missions, World Boss Missions, and Timeline Battle.
 
 This ranking will reset every Friday 1:00 (UTC+0), Thursday 5:00 PM (PDT)
 
 1. Story Mission
 It shows the 1st to 5th ranking of characters that are used the most for story mission 10-8.

 
2. World Boss
  It shows the 1st to 5th ranking of teams that are used in World Boss Mission. It will also show strikers as well
 

 
 3. Timeline Battle
 It shows the 1st to 5th ranking of the Characters that used in Timeline Battle
 

 
▣ Gear Upgrade Improvement
 
  For your ease of use, gear upgrade material has been simplified.
  After the update, Gear Upgrade only requires Gear Up Kit and Dimension Debris.
 
1. Upgrading to +5 is automatically by leveling up the character
 
  2. Upgrading after +6 requires Gear Up Kit

 
  3. Upgrading after +10 requires Gear Up Kit and Dimension Debris

 
4. Upgrading after +15 will stay the same

 * Except material simplicity, Gold cost remains the same.
 
▣ Other Improvements
 
1. If you have less than 10 6★ Characters you will be prompted to do the Hero Guide Quest. If you have already done the hero Guide Quest, then you will not be able to redo it.
2. Basic number of inventory slot has been expanded from 400 to 600.
- If you have previously expanded your inventory before, those expansion slots will be added to the new max total. The maximum amount of inventory you can have is 700.
3. Fixed following issues in Timeline Battle.
   - Some Leadership skills being applied to your opponents has been fixed.
   - Characters still being able to attack and survive whilst their HP is 0 has been fixed.
   - Web-resist Immune special gear not working has been fixed.
   - Losing after tagging to another character that was still alive has been fixed.
   - Fixed some character’s summoning / evasive / iframe skills that did not work correctly.
4. Fixed an issue with pressing back button after special gear upgrade that showed the gear not upgraded.
5. Fixed an issue with other users’ lead character always showing as a combat type.
6. Fixed an issue with Vision (Avengers : Age of Ultron) that his Special Gear does not show all the options available.
 7. Fixed an issue with Falcon(Including Uniforms) "Raptor Strafe", "Sky-High" skills not hitting correctly.
 8. Fixed an issue with Hawkeye(Including Uniforms) "Sure Shot” skill not hitting correctly.
9. Fixed an issue with Iron Man(Including Uniforms) "The One-Off” skill not hitting correctly.
10. Fixed an issue with Yellowjacket "Now You See Me", "Swarm Shot" skill not hitting correctly
11. Giant-Man(Including Uniform)
  - Fixed an issue with normal attack not hitting correctly
  - Fixed an issue with "Growing Pains" not hitting correctly
12. Fixed an issue with Sister Grimm(Including Uniform)’s Close attack not hitting correctly.
13. Fixed an issue with Singularity "Ablation", "Meteorite" skills not hitting correctly
14. Fixed an issue with Ant-Man(Including Uniforms) "Bug Squash" skill that activates as a striker not hitting correctly.
15. Fixed an issue with Winter Soldier(Including Uniforms) "Suppressing Fire” skill that activates as a striker that does not hit correctly
16. Fixed an issue with Proxima Midnight World Boss Mission that the damage dealt to Illusions deals damage to the Character who used the Illusion skill
17. Increased the rate of gaining Biometrics from Story Missions
18. Fixed an issue with Irregular damage being caused by skills that deal damage based on the number of hits.
19. Changed the Name of “Sharon Carter” to “Agent 13”
20. Fixed an issue with characters getting stuck on objects in Autoplay.
21. Proxima Midnight’s stage has been better optimized for performance.
22. Some names in game have been changed
 - Team UP ▶ Call Assistance
 - Multiplay ▶ CO-OP
 - Subscription Item ▶ Monthly Bonus Deal
23. Critical Rate and Dodge Rate bonuses due to level differences will work slightly differently between Tier-1 and Tier-2 Characters
